title: Quarter-comma Meantone with split sharps
summary: A short recording of a 1565 organ in Mantua tuned in quarter-comma meantone, showing split sharps in use. The extra keys provide separate D-sharp and A-flat for more tonalities.
why: Used as a concrete example of split-key instruments and an audible demonstration of the D-sharp versus E-flat difference.
